description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Monthly figures on where people go in Korea, from official statistics: where international visitors go, where Koreans go on weekends, places both go, places Koreans go and international visitors rarely do, places international visitors go and Koreans less so, the most-entered paid attractions, what changed most, arrivals by nationality, one province, or one district. Returns the top 10 lines with what the number means and its month, and the page URL for the full ranking, map and trend. Figures only, no recommendation.

place.description: For view "place": a district or a neighbourhood or place inside it, e.g. "Jongno-gu", "Haeundae", "Myeongdong".

region.description: For view "region": a province or metropolitan city, e.g. "Busan", "Jeju".

view.description: Which figures. "region" needs region; "place" needs place (a district).

name: get_korea_visitor_stats
title: Where visitors go in Korea
